Cheat sheet

Everything from this section on one page, to keep next to you while you practice.

Building blocks

  • Items are the visual pieces of an interface.
  • Properties describe how an item looks and behaves.
  • Bindings keep a property up to date with others.

Keyboard and remote

On a TV everything is reached with the arrow keys. Give every page one item with focus: true, and let KeyNavigation do the rest.

Further reading

  1. The Qt Quick documentation
  2. The Kirigami tutorial
  3. The Plasma Bigscreen developer guide

Press Back to return to the course, or Down to keep reading.
